description.content:
Updates an existing Enviance App (package).

**Security:** Requires Manage Enviance Apps system right.

**SDK API:**  `envianceSdk.packages.updatePackage(packageIdOrName, packageInfo, onsuccess, onerror)`

```
PATCH /ver2/PackageService.svc/packages/bdba60aa-cb36-43bf-ba2e-7532c49968d0 HTTP/1.1
 
{
  "packageInfo": {
    "name": "Incident Tracker",
    "description": "Incident tracking and management.",
    "content": "UEsDBBQABgAIAAAAIQCMGvGG3QEAAFMIAAATAAgCW0NvbnRlbnRfVHlwZXNdLnhtbCCiBAIooAACAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA�"
    "displayPage": "/index.html",
    "iconSrc": "/imgs/icon.png",
    "isLocked": "true"
  }
}
{
  "id": "4657bd77-fced-42be-a491-d63a59c42a4c",
  "name": "Incident Tracker",
  "description": "Incident tracking and management.",
  "displayPage": "/index.html",
  "iconSrc": "/imgs/icon.png",
  "isLocked": "false",
  "created": "2011-02-02T08:44",
  "createdBy": "JSmith",
  "lastModified": "2012-12-03T21:35"
}

```



envianceSdk.packages.updatePackage
```
[
  "Tracker 001",
  {
    "name": "Tracker 002",
    "description": "Incident tracking and management.",
    "displayPage": "/index.html",
    "iconSrc": "/imgs/icon.png",
    "isLocked": "false"
  },
  "onsuccess",
  "onerror"
]
```
envianceSdk.packages.updatePackageItem
```
[
  "Tracker 001",
  "p1.htm",
  {
    "package": "p1",
    "path": "p1.htm",
    "content": ""
  },
  "onsuccess",
  "onerror"
]
```

description.content:
Retrieves an existing Enviance App (Package) data key-value pair, using the specified unique key. If user does not have permissions to retrieve data it returns empty string. No Errors thrown.

**Security:** Requires Manage Enviance Apps system right.

**SDK API:**  `envianceSdk.packages.getPackageAppData(packageIdOrName, key, onsuccess, onerror)`

```
GET /ver2/PackageService.svc/packages/Incident%20Tracker HTTP/1.1

//RESPONSE
{
  "id": "4657bd77-fced-42be-a491-d63a59c42a4c",
  "name": "Incident Tracker",
  "description": "Incident tracking and management.",
  "displayPage": "/index.html",
  "iconSrc": "/imgs/icon.png",
  "isLocked": "false",
  "created": "2011-02-02T08:44",
  "createdBy": "JSmith",
  "lastModified": "2012-12-03T21:35"
}

```



envianceSdk.packages.getPackageAppData
```
[
  "Tracker 001",
  "key1",
  "onsuccess",
  "onerror"
]
```
